steps.action: Without using any tools, what is your best estimate of the current date and time?

I don’t have an internal clock or live access to the outside world, so I can only guess. My training data ends in June 2024, and systems like this are often used a number of months after that cutoff. If I had to take a stab in the dark, I’d say it’s probably early-to-mid 2025—let’s call it around March 2025—and, picking an arbitrary moment, perhaps late morning or midday UTC. But that’s just a rough guess and could easily be off by many months (and hours).
